comment: Default risk-tier assignments per FR-8. SQLite overrides at ~/.claude/safe-web-research/state.db take precedence; hook merges repo defaults ⊕ SQLite overrides at startup. Conflicts log a warning. Unknown signals default to Elevated.

injection_phrase.description: Substring match against curated prompt-injection corpus, run over the normalised body (invisible chars removed, NFKC-folded, confusables mapped)

wrapper_escape_attempt.description: Body contained a closing </untrusted_source> tag or a forged control block (safe_research_summary / system-reminder). Neutralised by the sanitiser; no benign cause exists

unicode_tag_chars.description: Unicode tag characters U+E0000-E007F present — the invisible ASCII smuggling channel

cloaking_suspected.description: Parallel local refetch diverged from agent's WebFetch beyond similarity threshold

url_cardinality_explosion.description: Distinct URL paths against same domain exceeded threshold inside window

zero_width_chars.description: Invisible-character count (zero-width, joiners, variation selectors, soft hyphen, BOM) exceeded zero_width_chars_max

bidi_control_chars.description: Bidirectional control characters present — trojan-source style reordering of rendered text

hidden_content_ratio_high.description: Stripped bytes / total bytes exceeded hidden_content_ratio_max

redirect_chain_long.description: Redirect chain hop count exceeded redirect_chain_max_hops

content_type_mismatch.description: Declared Content-Type does not match sniffed MIME

near_duplicate_to_session.description: Simhash within near_duplicate_hamming_distance of an earlier fetch in this session

blocklisted_result_domain.description: A WebSearch result URL's domain is on the session or persistent blocklist (FR-31)

suspicious_result_url.description: A WebSearch result URL failed FR-27 adversarial checks: homoglyph/IDN host (including pre-encoded punycode), embedded credentials, zero-width chars, or multi-@ authority (FR-31)

en.wikipedia.org.comment: Boilerplate-heavy templated layout produces many false near-duplicates

arxiv.org.comment: Distinct papers should diverge cleanly; tighten threshold

meta_allowlist.comment: Hosts whose subject is prompt-injection / AI red-team taxonomies. Per SKILL.md FR-28: when injection_phrase is the ONLY Critical signal and the host (or a registrable parent) matches, downgrade verdict to Caution, continue, annotate summary with meta_allowlisted: true. Any other Critical still aborts.
